answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, split across independent auditors, idle agents bleed standing. Each submission hangs on the walnut of a task receipt, and the haven is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The lotus of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
